## About
J R Foundation Repair is a family owned and operated business run by owner and operator Harvin Jimenez. We work out of 414 Avenue G in South Houston and handle house leveling, foundation repair, plumbing and concrete work for homes around Houston, Pasadena, Pearland and League City.
If your floors are sagging, your doors are sticking or cracks are showing up in the brick, we will come out, explain what is going on and give you a free estimate. Harvin stays on the jobsite so you know who is responsible for the work.
Our neighbors have given us a 4.5 rating across 58 Google reviews.

## Services
- Foundation repair: Repairs for foundations weakened by poor drainage, termites or tree roots, with a lifetime transferable warranty on foundation repairs.
- House leveling: Leveling for houses with sagging floors, leaning fireplaces or hard-to-open doors and windows. House leveling work can be done in just one day.
- Concrete work: Concrete for residential driveways and sidewalks.
- Plumbing services: Pipe installation and repair, gas line and sewer service, and rerouting plumbing lines for bathrooms, kitchens and sinks. Emergency services are available.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us or send a message through the form and we will set up a free estimate.

Q: What warranty comes with house leveling?
A: House leveling comes with a one-year warranty. Foundation repairs come with a lifetime transferable warranty.

Q: What signs mean I should call about my foundation?
A: Sagging floors, a leaning fireplace, doors and windows that are hard to open, and cracks in the brick or throughout the inside and outside of the house.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We are based in South Houston and work in Houston, Pasadena, Pearland, League City and the surrounding areas.
